responsibility: Implements the token-tree preprocessing pass used before reparsing macro invocation input in the Rust expander. This file walks DelimTokenTree contents and rewrites doc-comment tokens into their attribute-token equivalent forms, such as transforming outer and inner documentation comments into #[doc = "..."] or #![doc = "..."] token sequences, while cloning all other tokens unchanged and returning a desugared token tree for later macro parsing.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for token-tree desugaring: it defines TokenTreeDesugar::go, append helpers, and the visit(Token&) rewrite that turns doc-comment tokens into attribute token sequences, whereas rust-token-tree-desugar.h only declares the visitor class and entry point.
